name: Archie whole-factory watch (stuck builds, unrescued reviews, idle pool, disk/inodes, missing crons, deploy drift, red main, paused work, skipped triage, cost anomalies)

knobs.note: BH-4586: 0 stops the tick before any read. Read by bin/archie-fm-watch.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMW_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-fm-watch.log and the default. The per-project switch is the settings row archie.manage[.<project>] = on|observe|off, shared with archie-fm and archie-fm-queue; fleet-scope findings read archie.manage.hub.

BH-4586: seconds after which a `started` archie_actions row this lane left behind (a tick that died mid-lever) is closed failed with ONE ALERTS line. It is never reclaimed; the incident escalates to a ticket once archie.watch.escalate_s has passed. Read by bin/archie-fm-watch.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMW_RETRY_S:-1800}; outside 60..86400 is one warn line and the default.
Not a knob: bin/archie-fm-watch.sh sets it to 1 when it re-execs itself under its backstop timeout (1860 s), so the child does not wrap itself again. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-fm-watch.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: the host name(s) bin/archie-fm-watch.sh reads as this box instead of hostname, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-fm-watch.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: seconds of the outer backstop timeout instead of 1860, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam gate: bin/archie-fm-watch.sh honours ARCHIE_FMW_NOW, ARCHIE_FMW_HOST and ARCHIE_FMW_TICK_CEILING_S and sources ARCHIE_FMW_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.

BH-4586: read by bin/archie-fm-watch.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMW_STATE_MD:-/root/orchestrator/STATE.md}: the hub orchestrator's STATE.md, whose OWED TO OPERATOR lines past their expected-by are owed-overdue findings. Not readable = one log line and no finding. NOT settable from the control plane; only env/global.env on the box moves it.

BH-4586: read by bin/archie-fm-watch.sh as ${HARNESS_CHECKOUT:-/root/harness-checkout}: the hub checkout of main whose catalog/lanes.d/ and git history the cron sweep reads (a wired hub lane added more than archie.watch.cron_install_s ago and missing from crontab -l). Not a git checkout = the sweep is skipped with one log line. NOT settable from the control plane; only env/global.env on the box moves it.
